status: open: no bench article built or tested. Physical results are not required to accept the preliminary design; each gate is the recorded test with its pass and fail numbers
article: Pocket bench article to this layout: 15.74 deg floor, flared hood, check flap with its magnetic switch, two-roller nip on 1/2 in steel hex shafts driven by a NEO 550 and MAXPlanetary 36:1, the 100 mm lip on its sprung stop, the break beam and the range sensor. Station mock: 35 deg chute, 419 mm ramp, sill 952.5 mm. Real 4.5 in pipes at 0.50-0.82 kg, new and worn; trough mock per target.json.

gates.name: tread stiffness and friction
gates.test: Press a pipe 6 mm into each installed roller on a scale, three places along the roller; pull a pipe along a locked tread and along the UHMW floor
gates.pass_: 240-720 N at 6 mm per roller (40-120 N/mm); tread mu >= 0.3; floor mu 0.15-0.35. Adjust the wheel count or durometer until inside the band
gates.kill: Below 120 N at 6 mm (20 N/mm) or above 1440 N (240 N/mm) with every available wheel option

prediction.model: Receive passes from 30 N/mm, seats 11/12 at 20 and fails at 10; eject passes to 160 and stalls at 240; shafts deflect 1.1974 mm at 120
prediction.predicted: unknown: no stiffness data exists; the band is three times wide and the wheel count tunes it

gates.name: station receive
gates.test: 30 feeds released from rest on the station mock at dock gaps 0, 10 and 50 mm, nip on powered hold; 10 pushed at about 2 m/s; 10 with the robot disabled
gates.pass_: 40/40 powered feeds captive (flap switch closed) within 0.50 s of the pipe passing the flap (model 0.097-0.259 s); none through the nip; none back out; 10/10 disabled feeds stay in the pocket
gates.kill: Any pipe through the nip, or any pipe out of the inlet

prediction.model: 108/108 seated, captive 0.097-0.195 s, peak rise 7.93 mm; pushed 18/24; disabled 4/4

gates.name: eject into trough
gates.test: Stand-offs 0, 25, 50, 75, 100 mm x loaded bus 9.0, 10.5, 12.0 V x 10 ejects = 150; record tip departure speed and nip current
gates.pass_: >= 147/150 captured and still supported 2 s after a 120 mm withdrawal; every cell >= 9/10; nip never stalls; departure 0.5-1.6 m/s
gates.kill: Any cell at 7/10 or below, or a stall at 9 V

prediction.model: 480/480 captured at 9-13 V over 40-160 N/mm, departure 0.495-1.591 m/s, slowest 0.346 m/s in the nip; 125 mm stand-off 5/8
prediction.predicted: pass; the assumed 0.9 per stage efficiency is what this gate measures

gates.name: custody sled and drive-away
gates.test: 1, 3 and 8 g for 50 ms, forward and rearward, 10 each, nip on hold; repeat 3 g and 8 g disabled; 10 receive-and-go runs leaving 50 ms after the flap switch at 3 m/s2
gates.pass_: 60/60 powered retained; 40/40 disabled retained; 10/10 receive-and-go seated (beam blocked) within 0.5 s of stopping
gates.kill: Any loss at 3 g or below

prediction.model: powered 72/72, disabled 18/18; receive and go 24/24, seated within 0.073 s; without the flap 0/2

gates.name: end to end, two trips
gates.test: 20 consecutive two-trip cycles: feed, 5 m carry ending in 1.5 m/s2 braking, eject at sector A, return, feed, eject at sector B; record the lateral dock error at each eject
gates.pass_: >= 19/20 cycles with both pipes credited and no hand recovery; every lateral dock error within +/-70 mm

prediction.model: not simulated end to end; same-section control 24/180 captured
prediction.predicted: unknown: depends on the drivetrain's lateral dock accuracy, which this package does not model

gates.name: sensing and interlock
gates.test: 30 seated pipes, 10 displaced 10 mm toward the flap, 10 removed; 10 lip stowed and 10 deployed; range sensor at 0, 50, 100, 150 and 400 mm stand-off from the trough mock, 10 readings each; 8 g pulses on 30 seated pipes
gates.pass_: Every displaced or missing pipe flagged within 50 ms; every lip state correct; every range reading within +/-15 mm; no eject command accepted at 150 mm or beyond; no false loss through the pulses
gates.kill: Any eject command reaching the nip with the lip stowed, the pipe unseated or the stand-off beyond 150 mm

prediction.model: not simulated: beam window X 296-333 mm for the pipe centre and the 255.6 mm zone margin are geometry

gates.name: lip stop and frontal hit
gates.test: Static: pipe on the tip, measure sag. Drop the pipe 60 mm onto the land 20 times. Push the tip rearward with 300 N, 50 times; then drive the bench cart into a wall at 1 m/s, 5 times
gates.pass_: Sag <= 3 mm (model 0.99 mm); the lip folds behind the bumper face and returns within 1 mm every time; no crack; deploy within 1.0 s of release (model 0.172 s)
gates.kill: Any permanent set over 1 mm or any crack

prediction.model: landing 13.4 MPa, frontal 22.4 MPa against 62 MPa yield; rigid-stop control 94 MPa

gates.name: custody with the power off
gates.test: Nip drive unplugged from its controller. (a) Push a seated pipe through the nip with a force gauge, 5 times. (b) Stand the article nose-down (floor vertical, 1 g into the nip) with a pipe seated for 60 s, 5 times. (c) 8 g, 50 ms pulses into the nip, 20 times. Repeat (c) with the controller powered, disabled, in brake idle mode
gates.pass_: (a) every push-through force >= 61 N (model 71.8 N at 40 N/mm, 143.5 N at 80); (b) 5/5 stay seated; (c) 20/20 and 20/20 retained, pipe back on the seat (beam blocked) within 0.5 s
gates.kill: Any push-through force below 29 N (twice the 14.2 N stop load), any pipe out nose-down, or any loss in (c)

prediction.model: With the main power off the gearbox coasts and the pipe is held by the tread squeeze: 24/24 required cases retained over 40-160 N/mm (a 1.5 g stop for 0.5 s and an 8 g, 50 ms hit, main power off and brake idle mode), largest travel into the nip 3.79 mm. At 40 N/mm with the power off: sustained 6 g kept, 8 g lost; 50 ms hit 16 g kept, 24 g lost. Static push-through 71.8 N at 40 N/mm against a 14.2 N stop load. Control: rollers decoupled on a 20 N/mm tread lose the pipe at 8 g.
prediction.predicted: pass inside the G0 band; the force in (a) is also the G0 stiffness cross-check

measurementsFirst: G0: installed tread stiffness and the three friction coefficients
PVC restitution on UHMW and on the tread
Drive current through the squeeze at 9 V
decision: G0-G3 and G5-G7 pass: carry B'x into detailed design. G1, G3 or G7 fails inside the G0 band: keep the guarded-pan baseline A. G2 fails: revisit the lip or the ratio before A. G4 is a whole-robot gate and runs with the drivetrain.
